title: Manila to Singapore
content: SkyPeak operates 3 daily flights from Manila (MNL) to Singapore (SIN). Flight time is approximately 3 hours 40 minutes. Departures at 06:15, 13:00, and 20:45. Aircraft: Airbus A320neo (Economy and Business class). Fares start at $129 one-way Economy. Business class from $489. Changi Airport Terminal 3. Online check-in available. This route is popular for weekend getaways and business travel.

title: Manila to Tokyo Narita
content: SkyPeak operates 2 daily flights from Manila (MNL) to Tokyo Narita (NRT). Flight time is approximately 4 hours 30 minutes. Departures at 08:00 and 22:30 (red-eye). Aircraft: Boeing 787 Dreamliner (Economy, Premium Economy, Business, and First class). Fares start at $249 one-way Economy. The red-eye flight arrives at 04:45 local time, ideal for catching early Shinkansen trains. Narita Express train connects to central Tokyo in 60 minutes.

title: Manila to Hong Kong
content: SkyPeak operates 4 daily flights from Manila (MNL) to Hong Kong (HKG). Flight time is approximately 2 hours 10 minutes. Departures at 07:00, 10:30, 15:00, and 19:30. Aircraft: Airbus A321neo. Fares start at $99 one-way Economy. This is SkyPeak's most frequent short-haul route. Hong Kong International Airport has an Airport Express train to Central station in 24 minutes.

title: Manila to Sydney
content: SkyPeak operates daily flights from Manila (MNL) to Sydney (SYD). Flight time is approximately 8 hours 15 minutes. Departure at 23:55 (arrives 11:10+1 local time). Aircraft: Airbus A350-900 (Economy, Premium Economy, Business, and First class). Fares start at $399 one-way Economy. Meals and entertainment included on all classes. This is a popular route for Filipino diaspora and Australian holidaymakers.

title: Manila to Los Angeles
content: SkyPeak operates daily flights from Manila (MNL) to Los Angeles (LAX). Flight time is approximately 13 hours 30 minutes eastbound and 15 hours westbound. Departure at 23:30 (arrives 21:00 same day LAX local time). Aircraft: Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner (Economy, Premium Economy, Business, and First class). Fares start at $549 one-way Economy. All long-haul amenities included. LAX Tom Bradley International Terminal.

title: Manila to Seoul Incheon
content: SkyPeak operates 2 daily flights from Manila (MNL) to Seoul Incheon (ICN). Flight time is approximately 4 hours 15 minutes. Departures at 09:00 and 21:00. Aircraft: Airbus A330-300. Fares start at $219 one-way Economy. Seoul is a popular destination for shopping and K-culture. AREX express train connects Incheon Airport to Seoul Station in 43 minutes.

title: Manila to Bangkok
content: SkyPeak operates 2 daily flights from Manila (MNL) to Bangkok Suvarnabhumi (BKK). Flight time is approximately 3 hours 20 minutes. Departures at 07:30 and 16:45. Aircraft: Airbus A320neo. Fares start at $119 one-way Economy. Bangkok is a top leisure destination with rich culture, street food, and shopping. Airport Rail Link connects to central Bangkok in 30 minutes.

title: Manila to Dubai
content: SkyPeak operates daily flights from Manila (MNL) to Dubai (DXB). Flight time is approximately 9 hours 30 minutes. Departure at 01:30 (arrives 06:00 local time). Aircraft: Airbus A350-900. Fares start at $349 one-way Economy. Dubai serves as a major transit hub connecting to Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. SkyPeak has interline agreements with regional carriers for onward connections from DXB.
